question: Which of the following festivals is mainly celebrated in Vadakkunnathan temple of Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thrissur Pooram.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Thrissur Pooram is an annual temple festival clasp in Thrissur, Kerala, India.
 
• It is a clasp at the **Vadakkunnathan (Shiva) Temple** in **Thrissur** annually on Pooram day.
 
• The day during the moon rises with the **Pooram star **in the Malayalam Calendar month of Medam.
 
• The carnival was begun by **Raja Rama Varma, Maharaja of Cochin Sakthan Thampuran** in 1798.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The '**Thiruvathira**' festival is celebrated **to commemorate the plea of Goddess Parvathi** who used to regularly observe fast on Thiruvathira day in the name of Lord Shiva.
 
• **Bastar Dussehra** is a unique **cultural trait** of **Chhattisgarh**. Celebrated by the local people of the state with sufficient vigor, the festival of **Dussehra **connotes the supreme power of the** goddess Danteswari.**
 
• **Kullu Dussehra** is the renowned **International Mega Dussehra festival** observed in the month of October in the **Himachal Pradesh** state in northern India.
